sentences.text: This Criminal Petition under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is filed by the petitioner/A.1 seeking to grant anticipatory bail in the event of his arrest in Crime No.393 of 2022 of Disha Woman Police Station, Visakhapatnam registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

It is represented by the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor that the charge sheet was already filed against A.1 to A.4, but the same is yet to be registered.
As such, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that on receipt of summons, the petitioner would appear before the concerned court and do all the needful for furnishing sureties for appearance.
Accordingly, as per the request on both sides, the Criminal Petition is closed.

B.S. BHANUMATHI, J Date: 15.02.2023 Ksn Sri Lanke Vijaya Kumar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45715084/
